name: Potion of Growth
description:
Item that increases the experience points gained by the growth pets.
100% additional experience points are gained.

**How To Use**
Can only be used on growth pets.
Applied the instant it is used. Can only be used when level 5 or above.
Can be used simultaneously with Gold/Silver Time items.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
